transcript: I love getting to see theater that's in development still. I am somebody that I love to go to an early preview or an out of town tryout. And recently I've gotten really lucky and I've started to be invited to a couple of industry readings of plays and musicals. However, these are usually invite only. It's usually me and like a bunch of industry professionals that I'm wondering, how the hell did I get here? However, there's a new play reading series that has the intention of opening up that process. The Frontera series is a brand new play reading series hosted at the tank that intends to highlight brand new American playwrights that are at the cost of starting their careers. And these are open to the public. The intent is to have these monthly starting March 18th is the first one, and there's one in April and may as well. The first play reading is Baron by Alex Lynn. That's happening on March 18th. And great news. If you cannot go in person because you don't live in New York like me, there is a live streaming option for literally only $10. I'm really excited for this series. All of the plays were also curated by my friend Ryan, who has, like, really good taste in plays, so I trust him to find some good shit. And I cannot wait to see this first one in March.
